_comment: Components that vcpkg does not install (Qt official binaries, FetchContent dependencies). licenseFile is relative to the build directory; the Qt and FFmpeg entries have no file because the LGPL/GPL texts ship in compliance/licenses/.

components.name: Qt
components.note: Official Qt binaries, shipped as shared libraries next to the executable (users can replace them). Source: https://download.qt.io/official_releases/qt/

components.name: FFmpeg (Qt Multimedia backend)
components.note: Bundled with the Qt Multimedia FFmpeg backend; scripts/compliance/compliance.mjs ffmpeg verifies the shipped libraries were not built with --enable-gpl or --enable-nonfree.
